description: Kute, http://tusharkute.com Natural Language Processing • Natural Language Processing(NLP) is defined as the branch of Artificial Intelligence that provides computers with the capability of understanding text and spoken words in the same way a human being can. Natural Language Processing • Humans communicate with each other using words and text. • Natural Language Processing or NLP refers to the branch of Artificial Intelligence that gives the machines the ability to read, understand and derive meaning from human languages. • NLP process helps computers communicate with humans in their language and scales other language-related tasks • Allows you to perform more language-based data compares to a human being without fatigue and in an unbiased and consistent way.
